story: Santa Rosa, California. 9:43 PM, October 8, 2017. The Tubbs Fire started near Calistoga and reached Coffey Park in three hours.

data.buildings: proxy: developed-land cells scaled to pre-fire home count

simplifications: Homes are estimated from developed-land cells at pre-fire density (northern Santa Rosa, Fountaingrove, Larkfield-Wikiup and Coffey Park), not individual footprints.
Fire spread is a calibrated graph travel-time model (Dijkstra), not fire physics - one free speed parameter fit to the historical outcome.
One uniform historical wind (45 mph from 45 degrees) for all 12 hours; no ember spotting, no weather change.
Fuel breaks slow fire 20x rather than stopping it; costs are rough mechanical-treatment magnitudes, not bids.
Fuels are LANDFIRE LF2016_FBFM40 (pre-fire vintage), terrain LANDFIRE LF2020_Elev, both resampled to a 60 m grid.
